# Enums

The API sends these fields as numbers (or accepts only these words). Flags and MCP tools accept the names as well; `dna enums <Name>` prints the same list.

## AccountCurrency

Currency a reseller account is kept in (ResellerMeDto.accountCurrency).

| value | name | meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `TRY` |  |
| 2 | `USD` |  |
| 3 | `EURO` |  |

## AuthenticationType

SSL domain control validation method (authenticationType).

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `Email` | Approval e-mail to approverMail |
| `Cname` | DNS CNAME record |
| `Http` | HTTP file on the site |
| `File` | File-based validation |

## ChargeType

Direction of a balance transaction (AccountTransactionDto.chargeType, filter `--charge-type`).

| value | name | meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `Add` |  |
| 1 | `Subtract` |  |

## ContactType

Contact role (contactType). Registering with contacts needs all four roles unless useTrusteeContact is true. Unknown values are silently treated as Registrant by the API.

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `Registrant` |  |
| `Admin` |  |
| `Tech` |  |
| `Billing` |  |

## DNSSECMode

What to do with DNSSEC when changing the nameservers of a signed domain (DnsEditNameServerInput.dnssecMode).

| value | name | meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `Block` | Reject the nameserver change while DS records exist (safe default) |
| 1 | `KeepDnssec` | Keep DS records; you confirm the new DNS provider serves a matching DNSKEY |
| 2 | `DisableDnssec` | Remove all DS records at the registry first, then change nameservers |

## DNSSECOperationType

Kind of DNSSEC operation (DnssecOperationResultBaseDto.operationType).

| value | name | meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `Add` |  |
| 1 | `Remove` |  |
| 2 | `RemoveAll` |  |
| 3 | `Sync` |  |

## DNSSECStatus

DNSSEC state of a domain (DnssecInfoBaseDto.status).

| value | name | meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `Unsigned` | No DS record at the registry |
| 1 | `PendingEnable` | DS add sent, awaiting confirmation |
| 2 | `Signed` | At least one active DS record |
| 3 | `PendingDisable` | DS removal sent, awaiting confirmation |
| 4 | `Error` | The last DNSSEC operation failed |
